## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Prague, Czechia. It starts at Husova 241/7.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Visit the Choco Art Museum in Prague for a unique experience. With an entry ticket, you can enjoy art and interactive exhibits and taste over 15 varieties of chocolates in the museum.
>
> You also see chocolate sculptures, such as the legendary Golem and a miniature of the Charles Bridge in Prague. The museum mingles art with chocolate tasting, creating an activity that's sweet for the memory and the tastebuds.
